ontology.note: Design alignment to GenericInputConfiguration; not a claim that current receipts emit this type.

changes.description: Renamed from `observations` to `point_input`. The old identifier keeps resolving: a saved workflow naming `observations` is rewritten on open and stamped with sourceMigration, because the operation is unchanged and a rename must not refuse work the way a retirement does. `observations` is a category noun, and the title "Input data" said "input" where the identifier did not and shared no word with it -- so a reader had to learn a mapping that carried no information. The operation is importing observed points, and the title is now "Point data", which matches `table_input` and "Tabular data". Clears three violations: audited-name, role-word-in-title and title-type-agreement. No contract change: ports, output, parameters and behaviour are identical.
Heat examples use shared input editing. Legacy places and centers normalize on load without changing IDs, labels, references, geometry or scalar attributes; sourceMigration records adapter version 1.

evidence.note: Shared-input unit and Chromium regressions cover migration, data preservation, editor saving and offline EYE results; repository gate remains authoritative.
